analysis.reasonEn: Maintained wait-and-see for 3 consecutive sessions. RSI attempting rebound after entering oversold but not yet confirmed above 50. MACD histogram improving but still negative. Volume surge after 5 consecutive down days suggests potential bounce, but lack of trend confirmation warrants continued caution.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price($75,963.59) vs SMA5($77,727.94)/SMA20($79,926.71)/SMA50($81,988.45): Below short/mid-term trends, diagnosing weak position.
· Position vs SMA100($76,943.86)/SMA200($73,191.54): Approaching long-term support, neutral strength assessment.
· 52-week Position (36.7%) + Current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 35.5 → 38.6 (exiting oversold): Attempting to exit weak zone, further upside needs confirmation.
· MACD Histogram -520.2152 → -263.0304 (improving): Weakening bearish signal, potential bottoming.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (near Lower Band $75,526.6): Approaching lower band, exploring bounce potential.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($74,958.57): Above Pivot S1($72,773.57), short-term support zone.
· Swing Resistance ($75,988.4): Near current price, potential for short-term rebound on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Sideways): No clear Higher Low or Lower High formed, trend transition uncertain.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (2.04x vs 5-day avg): Movement gaining momentum, increasing bounce potential.
· Current Range Diagnosis (Accumulation Zone): Potential for buy consideration due to RSI oversold exit attempt and increased volume, but maintaining wait-and-see due to weak ADX trend.
